title: Refined K-Type Occurrence Proposition
body_html:
Refined K-Type Occurrence Proposition

If a covering datum \(\widetilde D\) for \(G\) has nonzero occurrence in the oscillator representation for \(V'\), then there exist a \(K\)-type datum \(\Sigma\) equivalent to \(\widetilde D\) and a target \(K\)-type datum \(\Sigma'\) such that \(\Sigma'\) is a theta lift of \(\Sigma\), and the corresponding \(K\times K'\)-type occurs in the generalized lattice model.
proof_html: The proof is by induction on the number of positive-depth blocks. Appendix B gives a building-indexed sum formula, allowing one to choose \(x''\) and a vector \(w\) whose moment map matches the top-depth part of the source datum. Kim-Murnaghan conjugacy moves this moment value into block-diagonal form. Lemmas 9.3 and 9.4 split the target space and lattice function into top and lower blocks. The top block is adjusted by Proposition 5.10 to satisfy \(M(bw)=b\Gamma\), while the lower block is handled by induction. Combining the two blocks gives the required lifted datum.
